name: Book purchase invoices with capex, double-billing and subsidiary controls

onet.task: Review, code and route purchase invoices for approval
dwas: review supplier invoices for correct expense coding
route invoices for approval and hold suspicious billings

steps.title: Open the supplier purchase invoice and review the line item
Recode the expense head away from small tools to capex when the equipment value exceeds the capitalization threshold

decision.description: Change the expense head from the small-tools account to the plants and machineries account for a high-value equipment purchase
decision.counterfactual: If the equipment value were below the capex threshold, the small-tools expense head would have been kept

steps.title: Set the cost center to Production for capitalized equipment and save the draft
Recognize a repeat billing pattern when a familiar supplier invoice amount appears again
Place the suspected duplicate invoice on hold before submission instead of booking it

decision.description: Hold the invoice with an On Hold tag rather than submit it, because it repeats a previously paid amount with only a suffix added to the old invoice number
decision.counterfactual: If the supplier had no history of double-billing or the amount differed from the prior invoice, the invoice would have been submitted normally

steps.title: Route invoices from the UK subsidiary to second approval before booking

decision.description: Escalate the invoice to Pending Second Approval instead of submitting it directly, because it belongs to the UK subsidiary company
decision.counterfactual: If the invoice were for the home company rather than the UK subsidiary, it would have been submitted without second approval

guardrails.text: Equipment purchases over 5,000 are always capex: code them to Plants and Machineries with the Production cost center, never to small tools.
This supplier double-bills every December: hold any invoice matching the previously paid amount with only a suffix added to the old invoice number, until the supplier confirms.
Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.

translations.de: Auf Kleingeräte gebucht, das ist bei einem Kompressor falsch.
translations.fr: Comptabilisé en petits outillages, c'est faux pour un compresseur.
translations.es: Contabilizado en herramientas pequeñas, eso está mal para un compresor.
translations.ru: Проведено по мелкому инвентарю — для компрессора это неверно.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Equipment over 5,000 is always capex here, so it goes to Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center, never to small tools.

translations.de: Anlagen über 5.000 sind hier immer Kapitalanlagen, sie gehören also auf Maschinen und in die Kostenstelle Produktion, niemals auf Kleingeräte.
translations.fr: Tout équipement de plus de 5 000 est toujours une immobilisation ici, donc il va en Installations et Machines et au centre de coûts Production, jamais en petits outillages.
translations.es: Los equipos de más de 5.000 son siempre capex aquí, así que van a Maquinaria e Instalaciones y al centro de coste de Producción, nunca a herramientas pequeñas.
translations.ru: Оборудование свыше 5 000 здесь всегда является капвложениями, поэтому оно относится к счету «Машины и оборудование» и центру затрат «Производство», но никогда — к мелкому инвентарю.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.

translations.de: Dieser Lieferant stellt jeden Dezember doppelt in Rechnung; zurückhalten, bis er bestätigt. Gleicher Betrag, nur ein Suffix an der alten Rechnungsnummer.
translations.fr: Ce fournisseur double-facture chaque décembre ; bloquer jusqu'à leur confirmation. Même montant, juste un suffixe sur l'ancien numéro de facture.
translations.es: Este proveedor factura por duplicado cada diciembre; retener hasta que lo confirmen. El mismo importe, solo un sufijo en el número de la factura antigua.
translations.ru: Этот поставщик каждый декабрь выставляет счёт дважды; придержать до их подтверждения. Та же сумма, просто суффикс к старому номеру счёта.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Pennick, that's for the UK company, in pounds.

translations.de: Pennick, das gehört zur UK-Gesellschaft, in Pfund.
translations.fr: Pennick, c'est pour la société britannique, en livres.
translations.es: Pennick, eso es de la empresa del Reino Unido, en libras.
translations.ru: Pennick — это британская компания, в фунтах.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.

translations.de: Alles von der UK-Tochter braucht eine zweite Freigabe durch den Controllingleiter, bevor es gebucht wird.
translations.fr: Tout ce qui vient de la filiale britannique nécessite une deuxième validation du contrôleur avant d'être comptabilisé.
translations.es: Todo lo de la filial del Reino Unido necesita una segunda aprobación del controller antes de contabilizarse.
translations.ru: Любые документы от британского филиала требуют второго одобрения финансового контролёра до проведения в учёте.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.

translations.de: Gleicher Betrag wie die Dezemberrechnung, die wir bereits bezahlt haben.
translations.fr: Même montant que la facture de décembre que nous avons déjà payée.
translations.es: El mismo importe que la factura de diciembre que ya pagamos.
translations.ru: Та же сумма, что и в декабрьском счёте, который мы уже оплатили.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
